'''Rian Ry''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], working as an official on an orbital navigation [[Space station/Legends|station]] that was located near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], she put a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] into contact with the [[Civilian Protection Guild]].
